release_read.basis: Diluted EPS $0.62 vs $0.57 consensus (+9%), NIM 3.48% above the CFO's 3.44-3.45% launch point, PPNR +17% QoQ on lower expense and higher fees, loans +2.1% and NIB deposits up; offset by classified loans rising to $35.0M (1.63%) on one $14.1M CRE relationship and a swing to a $0.8M provision. Sized below the +5.3% Q2 margin-beat reaction because part of the beat is expense/one-off (FHLB dividend) and the classified jump is a talking point for the 11:30 ET call.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast in brief (fallback, 5 estimates); finviz/Benzinga $0.57-0.58 per hunt https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=BMRC

key_line.detail: 3.48% vs 3.38% Q2, above the CFO's 3.44-3.45% launch point; cost of deposits 1.24% from 1.28%; CFO: 'modest net interest margin expansion over time', low rising-rate deposit beta. Credit offset: classified loans $35.0M (1.63%) from $19.9M, non-accrual 0.45%.

guidance.detail: No formal guidance; CFO language 'modest NIM expansion over time' is consistent with/slightly better than the Q2-call tone.

call.detail: Call at 08:30 PT = 11:30 ET, inside the session; classified-loan jump and NIM trajectory after the September hike are the likely questions.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was NIM above launch point vs a $0.57 consensus; NIM 3.48% and EPS $0.62 confirm it. Classified loans rising is the offset the thesis did not have.

expected.open_lag_note: Provisional before tape: thin name, bmo print, call at 11:30 ET.

recommendation.reason: Voorlopig: de cijfers bevestigen de long (winst $0,62 tegen $0,57 verwacht, rentemarge hoger dan beloofd). Houden tot de slotkoers.
